name: review-branch
one_liner: Multi-dim PR review (bugs / perf / tests) + verifier + score + advisor evolution

final_state_preview.diff: Python diff for `/api/users/<id>` — 38 lines added, 12 removed
final_state_preview.findings: 3 findings: missing null-check on `user_id`, missing test for the empty-result branch, an unclosed cursor in finally{}
final_state_preview.verified_findings: 3 of 3 verified by the verifier agent (no false positives)

evolution_proposal.rationale: Three runs over similar payments-API diffs consistently produced low risk scores (0.25-0.35) but every diff had injection patterns the reviewers didn't flag. The bugs / perf / tests dimensions don't include security framing. Adding a `security` reviewer would change findings and lift the risk score for genuine issues.
evolution_proposal.diff:
--- experience.yaml
+++ experience.yaml
@@ -34,6 +34,16 @@
       prompt: ./prompts/review.md
       reads: [diff]
       writes: [findings]
+    - id: security
+      kind: agent
+      phase: review
+      prompt: ./prompts/review.md
+      reads: [diff]
+      args:
+        dimension: 'security'
+        focus: 'injection, XSS, auth bypass, secret leak'
+      writes: [findings]
     - id: verify
       kind: agent
       phase: verify

tip: This is the loop that no other workflow framework closes: author → run → evolve → re-author. Run the same flow against a real PR with a SQL injection and you'll see the missed finding; apply this proposal and the score lifts.
